description: The stages of the pipeline from an input to its outputs (engines/pipeline.py): each a conditional over the input's profile, so the set of stages that run on an input is computed from these cards and every one that applies runs or says why not (CM50). `outside` names the engines that are no step of this path, with the reason.
name: stage

outside.cardmodel/engines/arena.py: the arena runs card-language programs against each other (`cardmodel arena`): a game loop over whole programs, not a step on one function
outside.cardmodel/engines/capabilities.py: the smoke checks of the core (CM37) call the engines, the pipeline among them, from `verify` and the self-run; a check is not a step of the path it checks
outside.cardmodel/engines/codefacts.py: facts about a whole source tree for `observe` and `learn` (which constructs occur where): a corpus reading, not a transformation of one function
outside.cardmodel/engines/codes.py: the positional and arithmetic codes of whole Gödel sets (`cardmodel godel`): bookkeeping of the ledger, read by the content stage through godel.py
outside.cardmodel/engines/conformance.py: the op x language matrix (CM17) measures the language cards themselves over every op; the targets stages measure one function's forms
outside.cardmodel/engines/coverage.py: the goals' metrics read from the latest verify and self-run; it reads the pipeline's coverage, it is not a stage of it
outside.cardmodel/engines/difficulty.py: difficulty of a whole card set for the self-run's choice of work; no step of one input's path
outside.cardmodel/engines/docs.py: generates LAWS.md, GOALS.md and the floors from the cards (`cardmodel docs`): documentation of the model, not a transformation of an input
outside.cardmodel/engines/formal.py: the formal core in Lean (T1-T6) checks the theory's own theorems; the proofs are of the model, not of one input
outside.cardmodel/engines/godel1931.py: the historical construction (Gödel 1931) as a card set, read by `cardmodel godel`; the content stage uses the model's own ledger (godel.py)
outside.cardmodel/engines/integrity.py: the integrity check of the model's own files and cards (`verify --only integrity`): it checks the registry, it is not a stage of it
outside.cardmodel/engines/laws.py: law discovery over the op cards (`cardmodel laws`) writes rewrite rules the canon and rewrite stages then read; it runs on the signature, not on an input
outside.cardmodel/engines/learn.py: learning over a corpus of files (`cardmodel learn`): proposes and promotes cards from many inputs' observations; the unit here is one function
outside.cardmodel/engines/lift_project.py: lifts a whole project tree (`lift-sweep`): a sweep over files, each function of which is this pipeline's unit
outside.cardmodel/engines/logic.py: the logic engine (rules, queries, proofs of facts) serves `cardmodel logic` and card-language programs; a function has no logic program
outside.cardmodel/engines/mine.py: mines candidate cards from a corpus for the self-run; a corpus reading, not a transformation of one function
outside.cardmodel/engines/observe.py: observes a code base for named cards against fallbacks (`cardmodel observe`): a corpus reading for learning
outside.cardmodel/engines/projects.py: project cards and their layering (`cardmodel status`): where the outputs go, not how an input is transformed
outside.cardmodel/engines/redefs.py: redefinition cards (what a definition was redefined to and why) for `rewrite` over cards, not over functions
outside.cardmodel/engines/selfcheck.py: the self-containment check (CM13, `verify --only selfcheck`): the program's own files
outside.cardmodel/engines/selflogic.py: the model's own card logic (the self layer) for the self-run; no step of one input's path
outside.cardmodel/engines/selfrun.py: the self-run cycle (CM38) schedules steps over the model, `translate` among them; it calls the pipeline, the pipeline does not call it
outside.cardmodel/engines/sweep.py: sweeps a corpus through `translate` (`cardmodel sweep`): a loop over files, each function of which is this pipeline's unit
outside.cardmodel/engines/theorems.py: theorem cards with their evidence (CM23) are statements about the model's cards; a function's claims are certificates on its card (the evidence group)
outside.cardmodel/engines/verify.py: the verify sections (`cardmodel verify`) run every check of the model, `pipeline` among them
outside.cardmodel/engines/witness_runner.py: runs the law cards' witness tests for the self-run (CM20): tests of the model, not of an input
